generation_budget.definition: The AGREE arm's role graph is unchanged: perception 1, solver 1, reviewer 3, planner 1, max_revisions 1, so rails.native_episode_config.load_native_episode_config resolves the program ceiling 1 + 2 * (3 + 1 + 1) = 11 contacts per row and 70 * 11 = 770 is the exact program maximum rather than a conservative safety bound. The sealed PLAN arm's realized rate on the whole roster was 5,425 contacts over 1,080 rows (5.023 per row), which on these 70 rows would be about 352 contacts; every row here is an intent-error row and so likelier than average to spend its revision budget, which is why the ceiling and not the average is registered. At the sealed arm's own 3.6819 GPU hours per 5,425 contacts the whole ceiling costs about 0.52 GPU hours. The train-exemplars store supplies the Solver phase and adds prompt tokens, never contacts. The budget is RUN-CUMULATIVE across every attempt of this run id, which is what makes the resume-recovery clause safe.

purpose: Cell CONV on the 70 TRAIN Fold A rows cell AGREE newly delivers: of the rows that receive their own gold intent's boundary entry only because of the agreement term, what proportion move from a wrong intent to the gold intent? That proportion IS the persuasion factor -- the one unmeasured term of the AGREE arm's declared expectation, which the arm states at the midpoint of [0, 1] and nothing more. The deliverable is P(correct | newly delivered) with a binomial CI95 plus the reverse count; multiplying it by the registered per-row headroom of the class the gain lands on (5.41 / 130 = 0.041615 pp SLU-F1, 12.04 / 130 = 0.092615 pp intent accuracy) gives the AGREE arm's re-declared expectation. The arm needs a conversion of at least 0.8582 -- 61 of these 70 rows -- to clear its own 2.5 pp bar at n = 1,080; it declares 0.4679. The intent-boundary Perception channel reads its own registered w_agree term over a pre-computed, self-excluded exemplar-intent vote: w_agree 1.0, w_cos unchanged at 1.0, w_prior unchanged at 0.0, and the DELIVERED width unchanged at 8 entries (fuse_coverage m 8 / c 1 / top_l 8). The RECALL width k is the store's full 60, because k is the provider's top_k_per_dimension and truncates by cosine BEFORE the ranker runs -- at 8 the agreement term is inert, measured. Not one byte of the treatment differs from the registered AGREE arm's: the same baseline content, model fragment, geometry, session, program, stores, exemplar k of 20, role graph, templates, normaliser and scorers. Only the roster and the ceilings differ, and both are arithmetic on 70 rows. THE ROSTER WAS SELECTED USING GOLD, OFFLINE, which is legitimate for a CONDITIONAL estimate on a TRAIN roster and for nothing else: NO POOLED OR ROSTER-LEVEL CLAIM MAY EVER BE MADE FROM THIS CELL, because its population was chosen by the mechanism's own effect. This cell claims NO benefit and asks for NO admission: under the measurement instrument's rule 5 a batch of 70 rows is a form proof by size, never evidence of benefit. Development numbers only (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim. Nothing here authorises a flight, a readiness flip or an admission entry.
